argument_macro_structure.dominant_argument_form: Recursive incremental refinement with dialectical synthesis
argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: High - premises are stated and restated with increasing specificity

argumentative_quality.dialectical_reasonableness: High - acknowledges counterarguments and integrates them
argumentative_quality.logical_relevance: High - all premises directly support the thesis
argumentative_quality.premise_acceptability: Moderate - relies on Whiteheadian metaphysics and aesthetic theory

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: Acknowledges limitations of theological redemption and subjective/objective dominance
objections_raised: Theological redemption alone insufficient for finite human experience
Subjective resonance dominance leads to sentimentality
Objective appraisal dominance leads to cold technicality

epistemic_stance_and_voice.certainty_language_frequency: Low - uses 'can', 'may', 'becomes' rather than absolute necessity

philosophical_orientation.thematic_focus: Temporal perishing, aesthetic redemption, divine preservation

structural_organization.structure_type: Spiral - each section restates and deepens the previous thesis

summary_of_core_decisions: The text presents a Whiteheadian problem (perishing of subjective forms), rejects purely theological redemption as insufficient, and proposes aesthetic emergence as the synthesis that integrates novelty and ritual, subjective resonance and objective appraisal, through hybrid prehensions and poetic insights, achieving both secular and theological redemption.

thesis_commitment.hedging_density_in_final_paragraph: Low - asserts redemption through aesthetic emergence
